45 year old woman with shortness of breath and Generalized edema"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"This is an online E logbook to discuss our patient’s de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian’s signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient’s problems through a series of inputs from the available global online community of experts intending to solve those patients' clinical problems with collective current best evidence-based inputs\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 45 year old woman, laborer by occupation, resident of Nalgonda came to medicine OPD with \u003Cb\u003Echief complaints \u003C\/b\u003Eof\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDifficulty in breathing since 2 hours\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGeneralized edema since 3 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of Present Illness-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 3 months ago, then she suddenly noticed edema of the feet. She continued to go to work and observed that her swelling has progressed to upper limbs and abdomen and face,\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EEdema was sudden in onset and rapidly progressive associated with pain, started with edema\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe pain was dragging type, insidious in onset and was throughout the day. Aggravated on movement and supine position. Relieved on medication and sitting.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain eventually spread to the entire body.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 months ago she went to a hospital in Nalgonda, where she was told she had some kidney related issue. She took medicine for 1 month irregularly.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe edema didn't subside, so she decided to come to KIMS where she was told she has to undergo dialysis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was apparently anxious and about it and left to Nalgonda govt. Hospital.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWhile in the waiting, she started having difficulty in breathing and immediated came back to KIMS.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o fever, local rise of temp, cough, cold, burning micturition, oliguria, headache\u0026nbsp; vomiting, loose stools and constipation and NSAID abuse\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPast history-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo similar complains in the past.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 LSCS done. 24years and 18 years ago\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETubectomy 18 years ago\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E4 years ago, she was diagnosed with DM when she went to local hospital because she fainted during her work. Treatment- tab. Glimepride 2mg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3 years ago, she was diagnosed with HTN when she went to local hospital because of fever. Treatment- tab. Atenolo 50 mg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 years ago, thorn price on the left little finger. Here we discuss our individual patient’s problems through a series of inputs from the available global online community of experts intending to solve those patients' clinical problems with collective current best evidence-based inputs\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 28 year old married woman, farmer by occupation, resident of kunjbihar came to medicine OPD with \u003Cb\u003Echief complaints\u003C\/b\u003E of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain and weakness in upper and lower limbs since 8 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of Present Illness-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 8 years ago, then had a sprain with sharp pain in the right hip region while drawing water from well. It was sudden in onset and dragging type of pain. Radiating towards\u0026nbsp; lower back and slowly spread to right upper limb amd lower limb. Pain aggravated on movement i.e., after work in the nights and relieved on medication, massage and rest.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIn the last 3 years, weakness has increased and she was not able to perform normal household works.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe went to an orthopedicean 3 years ago, pain was relieved on medication, so she discontinued taking medicine, which brought back the pain. Later, she was asked for investigation like blood and x ray. The doctor saw the result and asked her to consult a neurologist, which they didn't consult.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe then came to KIMS 1 year later.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o fever, headache, vomiting, constipation, loose stools, burning micturition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPast History-\u003C\/b\u003E n\/k\/c\/o HTN, DM, Asthma, CAD, Epilepsy, Thyroid disorders\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EFamily History\u003C\/b\u003E- no significant history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPersonal History\u003C\/b\u003E-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMarried\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep adequate\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movements regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddiction- tobacco chewing 3-4times\/day since 4 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAllergy- she had rashes all over her upper limbs after consuming egg 1 year ago\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EGeneral Examination\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPhysical Examination\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was conscious, coherent and Here we discuss our individual patient’s problems through a series of inputs from the available global online community of experts intending to solve those patients' clinical problems with collective current best evidence-based inputs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 36 year old woman, farmer by occupation, resident of Tirumalagiri came to medicine OPD with\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003Echief complaints of\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain abdomen since 1 month\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBlood in vomiting 1 episode 1 day ago\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of Present illness-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 month ago and then she developed, pain in the epigastric region, which is of squeezing type, aggravated on consumption of spicy, sour and non-vegetarian foods, sometimes relieved after an episode of vomiting. It is non radiating and no migration of pain. There’s is no positional variation.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe had had over 10 episodes of vomiting, in the last 1 month which is non projectile, non bilious and food as it’s content. Sometimes, early morning retching, induced vomiting. A day ago, she had an episode of vomiting with some blood which is dark brown in colour.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o fever, blotting, constipation, loose stools, cough, shortness of breath, chest pain. No retrosternal burning.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EMenstrual history-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMenarche at the age of 13 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMarriage at the age of 12 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E30 days\/ 5\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E8 pads per cycle\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o clots, white discharge, burning micturition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EObstetric History-\u003C\/b\u003E 3 children\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1st boy,by LSCS , now 20 years old\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2nd female, by LSCS, now 16 years old\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3rd boy, by LSCS, now 14 years old\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETubectomy done immediately after last delivery\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPast History-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E11 years ago, she was diagnosed with Renal Calculi, which was resolved on medication\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 months ago she was diagnosed with renal caliculi again, which was reported resolved in the ultrasound scan a day
